items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The next school was the Dudley school, James P. Timilty

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the schools that you went to, the names of the schools that you went to?
Yes. The first school was William Bacon. That was walking distance from my house. The next school was the Dudley school, James P. Timilty, and then Roxbury Memorial. They threw me out of there.
